title: Last Bronx
overview:
A gang war breaks out! The young fighters take up their weapons, their secret feelings held close to their hearts!!

At the end of a fierce battle, what awaits is...

A deluxe two-disc set! One disc is the arcade disc, and the other is a special disc packed with plenty of fun modes! A full training mode for people who aren't good at fighting games!

抗争勃発！若者達は秘めたる思いを胸に武器を取る!!

壮絶な闘いの果てに、待つものは・・・。

豪華2枚組！1枚をアーケードディスク、もう1枚をスペシャルディスクとして、豊富なお楽しみモードを用意！格闘ゲームが苦手な人のためのトレーニングモードが充実！
